summary: Replaced ghost-character 1v1 duel lobby with a shared lobby where both players are visually present, ready up manually via a Ready button, and start simultaneously via a wall-clock synchronized countdown. All 6 requirements implemented across 6 files. All quality gates pass (lint, typecheck, tests: 650/650).

artifacts.description: Reduced GHOST_RENDER_DELAY_TICKS from 8 to 4 (~133ms) and SMOOTH_FACTOR from 0.35 to 0.20 for more responsive opponent rendering at higher snapshot frequency
Changed SNAPSHOT_EVERY_TICKS from 2 to 1, doubling snapshot broadcast frequency from ~15Hz to ~30Hz for smoother opponent display
Added 'unready' to DuelEvent type, added updatePresence method to RealtimeHandle interface and implementation, added ready field to enterPresence data

Added readySlots and hiddenSlots options; ready glow (signal-lime radial gradient) behind ready characters in lobby; name tags shown for all players in lobby/countdown; hiddenSlots skip in player draw and off-screen indicator loops
Added readySlots and hiddenSlots props, threaded through to paintClimbFrame via optsRef

Major rewrite: replaced auto-ready PracticeGame warm-up with static WaitingLobby (frozen MatchState, single idle character). DuelGame now has manual Ready/Unready buttons, opponent presence detection with join beat, wall-clock countdown sync (coordinator sends countdownStartsAt = Date.now() + 500ms), readySlotsSet/hiddenSlotsSet passed to ClimbCanvas, 60s nudge + 120s auto-forfeit unready timeout

acceptanceCriteria.AC-1: Ready Button with Visual Feedback: signal-lime Ready pill button in lobby, toggles to Unready (secondary style), ready glow (radial gradient) behind ready characters, checkmark in HUD altitude bar
acceptanceCriteria.AC-2: Opponent Live Presence: opponent rendered at full character fidelity via paintClimbFrame with hiddenSlots suppressing absent opponents, join beat fires on presence enter, name tags shown for all players in lobby/countdown
acceptanceCriteria.AC-3: Wall-Clock Countdown Sync: coordinator sends countdownStartsAt = Date.now() + COUNTDOWN_BUFFER_MS in start event, both clients derive countdown numerals from wall clock via 50ms setInterval, eliminates drift from sim tick counting
acceptanceCriteria.AC-4: Opponent Joined Entrance Beat: joinBeat fires on opponent presence enter/present action (guarded by joinBeatFiredRef to fire only once), replaces old phase-transition trigger
acceptanceCriteria.AC-5: Unready Timeout: 60s READY_NUDGE_MS shows 'Ready up!' nudge text, 120s AFK_FORFEIT_MS auto-forfeits via handleLeave, timers reset on ready/unready toggle
acceptanceCriteria.AC-6: Full-Character Opponent Rendering: SNAPSHOT_EVERY_TICKS=1 (~30Hz), GHOST_RENDER_DELAY_TICKS=4 (~133ms), SMOOTH_FACTOR=0.20, opponents rendered through standard paintClimbFrame player loop with full fidelity

qualityGates.typecheck: pass (zero new errors; all pre-existing TS7006 implicit-any warnings unchanged)

architecturePreserved: Independent-simulation netcode: each client runs its own climb, no lockstep
Server-authoritative results via re-simulation of input logs
Ably pub/sub + presence for realtime transport (channel-per-duel)
Seed oracle prevention (R-5): seed withheld until opponent joins
Fixed-timestep simulation at 30Hz with rAF accumulator pattern

learnings.insight: All TS7006 implicit-any errors in useRace.ts, realtime.ts, and DuelRoom.tsx are pre-existing (confirmed by stash-compare). Zero new type errors introduced.
learnings.action: When verifying typecheck, filter for new errors only -- the baseline has ~14 TS7006 warnings across these files.

learnings.insight: The WaitingLobby component creates a frozen MatchState via createMatch() with no simulation loop. This is intentional -- the lobby is a static scene, not a playable warm-up.
learnings.action: Do not flag the absence of useClimb/useRace in WaitingLobby as a bug -- it is by design.

learnings.insight: Wall-clock countdown uses Date.now() which is subject to clock skew between clients. The 500ms COUNTDOWN_BUFFER_MS absorbs typical skew for LAN/friend play. Not suitable for competitive ranked without NTP sync.
learnings.action: Verify countdown derivation uses Math.max(0, ...) to clamp negative values from clock skew.

learnings.insight: Snapshot frequency doubled from ~15Hz to ~30Hz (SNAPSHOT_EVERY_TICKS: 2->1). This increases Ably message volume per match. For 2-player duels this is well within Ably's per-channel limits.
learnings.action: Monitor Ably message usage if scaling beyond 2 players per match.
